# netboxplugins_dns_record (Data Source)

Reads one NetBox DNS record.

Plugin: `netbox-plugin-dns` (experimental). API: `/api/plugins/netbox-dns/records/`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netboxplugins_dns_record" "by_id" {
  id = 42
}

data "netboxplugins_dns_record" "by_filter" {
  filters = { name = "example" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) NetBox query parameters on `/api/plugins/netbox-dns/records/` that select exactly one object, for example `{ name = "example" }`.
- `id` (Number) NetBox ID of the object. Set either `id` or `filters`.

### Read-Only

- `absolute_value` (String)
- `active` (Boolean)
- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values as strings; lists and objects as JSON (`jsonencode`).
- `description` (String)
- `disable_ptr` (Boolean) Disable PTR record creation.
- `expiration_date` (String)
- `expired` (String)
- `fqdn` (String)
- `ipam_ip_address` (Number) IPAddress linked to the record. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `managed` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `ptr_record` (Number) PTR record related to an address. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `status` (String) One of `active`, `inactive`, `expired`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tag names.
- `tenant` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `ttl` (Number)
- `type` (String) One of `A`, `A6`, `AAAA`, `AFSDB`, `AMTRELAY`, `APL`, `AVC`, `BRID`, `CAA`, `CDNSKEY`, `CDS`, `CERT`, `CNAME`, `CSYNC`, `DHCID`, `DLV`, `DNAME`, `DNSKEY`, `DS`, `DSYNC`, `EUI48`, `EUI64`, `GPOS`, `HHIT`, `HINFO`, `HIP`, `HTTPS`, `IPSECKEY`, `ISDN`, `KEY`, `KX`, `L32`, `L64`, `LOC`, `LP`, `MB`, `MD`, `MF`, `MG`, `MINFO`, `MR`, `MX`, `NAPTR`, `NID`, `NINFO`, `NS`, `NSAP`, `NSAP_PTR`, `NSEC`, `NSEC3`, `NSEC3PARAM`, `NULL`, `NXT`, `OPENPGPKEY`, `PTR`, `PX`, `RESINFO`, `RP`, `RRSIG`, `RT`, `SIG`, `SMIMEA`, `SOA`, `SPF`, `SRV`, `SSHFP`, `SVCB`, `TA`, `TLSA`, `TXT`, `TYPE0`, `UNSPEC`, `URI`, `WALLET`, `WKS`, `X25`, `ZONEMD`.
- `value` (String)
- `zone` (Number) Zone the record belongs to. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
